description: Four-input utility mixer with a level control on each input, a main output and an inverted copy of that output

params.text: Sets how much of the input on its row reaches the mix; it attenuates only, or attenuates and inverts, depending on the polarity switch
In the UNIPOLAR position the four row knobs run from silence to full; in the BIPOLAR position they run from fully inverted through silence at the centre to full
Sets the level of both outputs, from silence at one end of its travel to full at the other

inputs.text: Carries its row into the mix; with nothing patched here a steady 10V is used, so this row's knob works as a voltage source
Carries its row into the mix

outputs.text: The four rows summed and scaled by the output level knob, clamped to 12V either way
The mix with its polarity flipped

notes: the O/L lamp lights whenever the mix passes 10V, and the output is clamped at 12V either way
the output level knob starts fully down, so nothing reaches either output until it is turned up
this module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and every output carries a single channel
